scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration supports, but does not replace, the all-parameter factor-language and border proof. No third-party paper or private record is incorporated as an artifact.
scientific_limitations: Only alphabet sizes q>=3, pairwise distinct cyclic run labels, positive run lengths and integer powers k>=2. No assertion for binary or non-unique run labels; no independent audit.
title: The complete minimal-absent-factor spectrum of cyclic distinct-run powers
